correctness.rationale: The no-local-maximum criterion is an exact iff for weak connectivity. Counting valley permutations yields the conditioning event and independent fair placement bits. The ordered interior gap values and outer gaps remain independent of their rank permutation by symmetry of Dirichlet spacings. The exact second moments use the directly integrated minimum-gap survival function (1-mt)^n and standard Dirichlet moments. Conditional Lindeberg applies to weighted independent fair bits, with maximum gap O_P(log n/n), n times squared-gap sum converging to 2, and negligible outer boundary term. An independently implemented rational checker enumerates n=2..9 rank permutations and integrates the full moment vector through exponential order-statistic increments; every case passed. This finite code is corroboration only, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full-size connected component is a canonical rare event in 1-nearest-neighbor spatial clustering. The reciprocal pair is the unique root of its two in-directed branches. Its exact rank law, finite rank–coordinate moments and genuinely correlated joint Gaussian fluctuations reveal both topological and spatial localization at a scale that ordinary component counts or lengths cannot provide. The conditional midpoint variance asymptotic to 1/(2n) quantifies a non-obvious doubling of the familiar 1/(4n) central order-statistic variance scale; the dimensionless correlation tends to 1/sqrt(2). These are motivated natural geometric invariants, not arbitrary parameter tuning.
